+def ledger(data, priority, tax_base):
+    half_up = data["rounding"] == "half_up"
+    def rnd(n, d=10000):
+        return (n + d // 2) // d if half_up else n // d
+    chosen = {}
+    cutoff = data.get("cutoff", 10**9)
+    for pos, event in enumerate(data["events"]):
+        seq = event.get("sequence", 0)
+        if seq > cutoff:
+            continue
+        eid = event.get("id", "anonymous:" + str(pos))
+        key = ((event.get("revision", 0), pos) if priority == "revision" else
+               (seq, event.get("revision", 0), pos))
+        if eid not in chosen or key > chosen[eid][0]:
+            chosen[eid] = (key, event)
+    balances = dict(data.get("opening", {}))
+    for _, event in chosen.values():
+        if event.get("void", False):
+            continue
+        raw = event["price"] * event.get("quantity", 1)
+        discount = min(10000, max(0, event.get("discount_bp", 0)))
+        net = rnd(raw * (10000 - discount))
+        base = raw if tax_base == "original" else net
+        total = net + rnd(base * event.get("tax_bp", 0))
+        if event.get("kind") == "refund":
+            total = -total
+        key = event.get("account", "default") + "|" + event.get("currency", "USD")
+        balances[key] = balances.get(key, 0) + total
+    return {"balances": balances}

+def dependency_solver(data):
+    packages = data["packages"]
+    names = sorted(packages, reverse=True)
+    features = set(data.get("features", []))
+    roots = data["roots"]
+    blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+    pins = data.get("pins", {})
+    options = {}
+    for name in names:
+        rows = packages[name]
+        vals = sorted(row["version"] for row in rows
+                      if row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                      and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name]))
+        options[name] = [None] + vals
+    best_vec = None
+    best = None
+    for vals in product(*(options[n] for n in names)):
+        selected = {n: v for n, v in zip(names, vals) if v is not None}
+        if any(n not in selected or not lo <= selected[n] <= hi
+               for n, (lo, hi) in roots.items()):
+            continue
+        graph = {n: [] for n in selected}
+        valid = True
+        for name, version in selected.items():
+            row = next(r for r in packages[name] if r["version"] == version)
+            for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                if feature and feature not in features:
+                    continue
+                target = dep["name"]
+                if target not in selected or not dep["min"] <= selected[target] <= dep["max"]:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                graph[name].append(target)
+            if not valid:
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+        # Every selected package must be reachable from a root through active dependencies.
+        reachable = set()
+        stack = list(roots)
+        while stack:
+            n = stack.pop()
+            if n in reachable or n not in selected:
+                continue
+            reachable.add(n)
+            stack.extend(graph[n])
+        if reachable != set(selected):
+            continue
+        visiting, done = set(), set()
+        def acyclic(n):
+            if n in visiting:
+                return False
+            if n in done:
+                return True
+            visiting.add(n)
+            if any(not acyclic(m) for m in graph[n]):
+                return False
+            visiting.remove(n)
+            done.add(n)
+            return True
+        if any(not acyclic(n) for n in graph):
+            continue
+        vec = tuple(selected.get(n, -1) for n in names)
+        if best_vec is None or vec > best_vec:
+            best_vec, best = vec, selected
+    return {"versions": best} if best is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}

+def intervals(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    allowed_jobs = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] not in blocked]
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for chosen in combinations(allowed_jobs, k):
+        ids = {j["id"] for j in chosen}
+        if not mandatory <= ids:
+            continue
+        counts = Counter(j["group"] for j in chosen)
+        if any(not lo <= counts.get(g, 0) <= hi for g, (lo, hi) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        # At most two intervals active; half-open endpoints permit touching.
+        events = []
+        for j in chosen:
+            events.append((j["start"], 1))
+            events.append((j["end"], -1))
+        active = 0
+        ok = True
+        for _, delta in sorted(events):
+            active += delta
+            if active > 2:
+                ok = False
+                break
+        if not ok:
+            continue
+        value = sum(j["value"] for j in chosen)
+        sorted_ids = tuple(sorted(ids))
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and sorted_ids > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, sorted_ids
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
